name: Darjeeling
summary: The Queen of Hills: Himalayan views of Kanchenjunga, tea estates, the Toy Train and Tibetan culture.
season_note: March to May and October to November have the clearest mountain views. June to September is monsoon with landslides; December-February is very cold.
avoid_note: Landslides can block the Siliguri-Darjeeling roads in heavy rain.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre, usually medical/tourist/e-visa categories as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Bagdogra (Siliguri) (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India)
reach.note: Then 3-4 hours by shared jeep to Darjeeling.

reach.how: Dhaka to Siliguri via Banglabandha-Fulbari or Benapole route, then shared jeep to Darjeeling
reach.note: Long but cheaper. Bangladesh-Siliguri land routes may need prior permission, so check.

reach.how: Kolkata to New Jalpaiguri (e.g. Darjeeling Mail), then jeep to Darjeeling

local.group_fare: 100-200 BDT per seat for sightseeing hops

local.note: Tiger Hill early sunrise runs cost more.
Steam ride to Ghum and back.

attractions.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise
attractions.what: Pre-dawn trip for sunrise over Kanchenjunga and sometimes Everest.
attractions.tip: Leave around 3:30-4am; bring a warm jacket.

attractions.name: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train)
attractions.what: A UNESCO World Heritage narrow-gauge steam ride through Batasia Loop.

attractions.name: Batasia Loop and War Memorial
attractions.what: A spiral rail loop with a garden and mountain views.
attractions.tip: Come right after the toy train.

attractions.name: The Mall and Chowrasta
attractions.what: The heart of town with cafes, shops and tea stalls.
attractions.tip: Try tea at Chowrasta and shop for Darjeeling tea.

attractions.name: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute and Zoo
attractions.what: Museum on Everest expeditions and the snow leopard breeding centre.
attractions.tip: Tickets are combined; open daily except some Thursdays.

attractions.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
attractions.what: A working tea estate producing famous Darjeeling tea.
attractions.tip: Factory tours are best in the morning.

attractions.name: Ghum Monastery and Peace Pagoda
attractions.what: Tibetan Buddhist monasteries and a white peace pagoda with views.
attractions.tip: Dress modestly; ask before photographing monks.

attractions.name: Rock Garden and Ganga Maya Park
attractions.what: Landscaped garden with waterfall on a hill road.

budget.note: Basic lodges; cold in winter, check for heater.

luxury.note: A few colonial-style hotels and tea resorts.

rules: Drone use is restricted in many areas of the Himalayan border region.
Dress modestly at monasteries; remove shoes.
Plastic bag bans operate in parts of the hills.
Inner-line style permits are not needed for Darjeeling itself.
